clock.ts.why: the real Clock itself: every other read goes through it or Sys

progress.ts.why: a progress record's updatedAt and its rate: display

controller/forward.ts.why: the time on an envelope the controller makes, a signed statement's time (the box judges its 5 minutes), and when a status was read: display

controller/main.ts.why: the controller's Clock, and the time on its own envelopes and events: labels

controller/notify.ts.why: when a box was first not reached, when each note was last said, and the hold lease's times: a step only moves when a note is said again

controller/pair.ts.why: when a box was paired, and the time on the controller's events: labels

controller/update.ts.why: when the controller last looked for an update, and the time on its events: a step only looks sooner or later

keys.ts.why: a GitHub App JWT's iat and the clock offset GitHub reports: GitHub judges the JWT

github.ts.why: a GitHub App JWT's iat, for the loop and connect, the offset GitHub reports, and a failure's time for a status line

connectflow.ts.why: when a connect began, and the waits for GitHub, a code and the keeping phase: a step only ends a wait, which changes nothing and says so

watchdog.ts.why: a JWT, and whether the hourly workflows check and the last run are recent: a row's SKIP and display

away.ts.why: days until a date and recent logins: display

awaychecks.ts.why: how long ago the loop's last request and beat were: rows that say OK with a time; the power log's last 30 days, a WARN only; when a lasting change lapses, with mono and the boot beside it

checks.ts.why: the guard's and the workspaces state's freshness (a stale read FAILs, so a step fails closed) and how recent a loss or a moved log is: display

rows/guard.ts.why: the guard's record's freshness: a stale read FAILs, so a step fails closed

cli.ts.why: the answers envelope's at, for a usage error, a rename and every answer: a label; a streamed line's at: a label

ops.ts.why: screens and log reads, the undo's lock time, a pin's label, the hourly line for an unreadable watch, and the rollback watch's wall time: decideWatch uses it only for a watch with no mono count (v2.6.1's, or a clock it can't read), capped at 3 h. Remove's op record takes its start, end and phase times from it, for people to read; no deadline or lapse rests on them. A stale or stopped remove's end time, and the update lock's note of when remove took it, too.

install.ts.why: installedAt labels, the lock's time, and the wait for Tailscale to start: a step only waits less or more

availability.ts.why: the time label in controlNow's wall: control.json's since and the op's times, for people to read. A forced deadline is on this boot's mono (forceAt), and the break-glass stop's wait is counted

loadcmd.ts.why: the load command's now for its session's labels and freshness: display and a refusal to start

queue.ts.why: when the queue was read and a run's queued time when GitHub gives none: the scheduler's order; a refusal's time, for its clock offset and a rate limit's wait when GitHub sends no Date

kinds.ts.why: the scheduler's now: when slots became ready or busy, an idle VM's turn, and when a VM was told to give way: a step only reorders a choice, gives an idle VM's turn away or ends a wait for a VM to go; no running job is ended

gate.ts.why: the workspaces gate's now: the state must be within 3 minutes either way, so a step fails closed

workspace/agent.ts.why: a request's time (the guard judges it), the wait for an answer, the workspaces state's freshness (fails closed both ways), and progress labels

workspace/pass.ts.why: the workspaces pass's now: its beat and when a failed fence proof is tried again, both timers, either way of a step

passes/v2.ts.why: the logins keeper's minute: a timer

passes/keeping.ts.why: the wall part of a Moment: a pending change and an outcome lapse on the wall clock too, and mono and the boot hold them to their limits

core/passes.ts.why: when each guard pass starts and ends: a pass's timing for its row

core/events.ts.why: an event's time and id, and the minute windows of its rate limits: a step only shortens or lengthens a window

core/spool.ts.why: a stale temp name in a spool (removing it early costs a resend) and the spool pass's time budget (a step leaves requests for the next pass)

core/child.ts.why: an op's end time and spawn time, and the 30 s a new job has to take its lease: a step only changes that grace; a free lease is the proof. Op deadlines are on mono

guardwatch.ts.why: a beat's wall time and a log line's time, for people to read only: every age is judged on mono

guard.ts.why: the guard record's time, its full pass timer, and the freshness readers check (a stale record fails closed). A VM start judges a loss by mono and the boot too

loopwatch.ts.why: a restart record's time label, and vmStarting, which only puts off a one-time move of Softnet for a loop older than v2.5.1 while a VM starts. Whether a beat has gone quiet is judged on mono alone

loop.ts.why: the loop's labels, beats, timers and state times for screens, pull and peer waits, give-way and sampling timers. Job ceilings and vmMaxHours are on mono alone, the drain on the boot uuid, and a VM start's loss on mono and the wall clock both. A forced stop's mark time, a label.

cmd/daemons.ts.why: moved from cli.ts: the load session's wanted read and the workspaces hold's freshness for the loop, which fails closed both ways. The guard's step-down proof reads no clock: a new guard record file

cmd/job.ts.why: the timings' now, --since back from now, how long a live job has run, which queued lines are fresh, and when a stop was asked: display and labels

cmd/logins.ts.why: moved from cli.ts: the now the logins screen counts back from: display

cmd/status.ts.why: moved from cli.ts: the now for status's recent-logins line: display

cmd/workspace.ts.why: moved from cli.ts: the workspaces screen's now, and the agent commands' now for the state's freshness, which fails closed both ways, and their waits for the guard's answer, which give up and change nothing

shell.ts.why: the agent shell's refusal envelope's at: a label

broker.ts.why: the hour the GitHub key keeper's counts are kept under, and GitHub's Date against the box's for the clock guard: display and a reason

cmd/connect.ts.why: when the connect op began, and how long the listener may live inside the op's deadline: the op's record and GitHub's created_at decide

connectchild.ts.why: the code wait's end when the op has no deadline: the op's record ends the wait first

rows/connect.ts.why: how old the keeper's counts file is, for a WARN row: display

core/dispatch.ts.why: a request's 2 minutes and a signed statement's 5 minutes: times another machine wrote, which only the wall clock can judge; the nonce is what makes a signature work once

passes/requests.ts.why: a statement's 5 minutes and a request's time when the spool is over its cap, and a dropped request's outcome time: times another machine wrote, or a label; nothing is removed by it but what the spool's cap already removes

jobs.ts.why: when a stop was asked: a label in the stop's file

passes/control.ts.why: the time label on a control.json written again as paused

opcmd.ts.why: op list --since: a duration back from now, which only shows more or fewer records; and a loop op's cancel time, a label

tools/bake.ts.why: the bake's wait for its guest to shut down, and the base record's time: a step only ends a wait sooner or later, and the time is a label

tools/inloop.ts.why: a baking slot's beat and times, as every slot's are written, and a refresh op's end time: labels and beats

tools/pass.ts.why: when the store's hashes were last checked and when a failed fetch or bake is tried again: a step only checks sooner or later

cmd/tool.ts.why: when a tool refresh was asked, and how long the command watches it: a step only stops watching sooner or later, and the refresh carries on
